findings.description: The plan requires exact credential requirements, but the proposed catalog mostly pins credentials_required as a boolean and does not lock the per-item env-var name list or display shape. Without a deterministic list of credential names, offline fixture checks and operator-facing setup guidance can pass while still failing to tell the operator what credentials are required.
findings.recommendation: Pin a non-secret credential_requirements field as a list of required env-var names per integration item, render that list, and test that only names, never values, flow through provider, cache, what-now, and operator-console surfaces.

findings.description: F003 says gated Firebase deploy and realtime-smoke items always render, while F004 says only genuinely pending integrations occupy the needs-action band. The plan does not pin the band/status behavior for unmet triggers, so an implementation could either hide the item or incorrectly show not-yet-needed Firebase work as needing action.
findings.recommendation: Pin the gated-state matrix: unmet trigger renders visibly outside needs_action with trigger_condition copy, met trigger plus missing requirements becomes pending, and passed evidence moves the item to the quiet band.

findings.description: F002 tests the smoke writer and F004 tests status derivation with fixtures, but the plan does not require the completion-test path where the rendered static-dashboard ActionItem exact_command is executed, writes evidence, and then the real provider-to-render rebuild flips that integration's status without hand-editing.
findings.recommendation: Add one offline end-to-end fixture test that reads the rendered static-dashboard item, runs its exact_command against fixture state, rebuilds the real cache/surface path, and asserts the static-dashboard integration moves to smoke-passing or quiet status.
